lines.text: mandatum magnum esi lege ait illi Jheesus diliges domnium

lines.label: tmp1l17sfb8_region6
lines.text: no beatis videtur de Christoistero cuius filius est dicunt ei om

lines.label: tmp1l17sfb8_region7
lines.text: juddicit eis ihese sus quomodo davidnirtu

lines.label: tmp1l17sfb8_region8
lines.text: vocat eum dominum dicens dixit dominius domino me

lines.label: tmp1l17sfb8_region12
lines.text: co confide fili remittuntur tibi peccata terua evovac

lines.label: tmp1l17sfb8_region15
lines.text: ficans Deum et omnis plebs ut jidit dedit laudem Deo ex

lines.label: tmp1l17sfb8_region19
lines.text: in venite ad nuptias Allelvya exovae

lines.label: tmp1l17sfb8_region21
lines.text: auten ret ut videret discummbentes et jndit ibi hominen
